verdict.rationale: Airwallex supplies building blocks for background automation: real-time webhooks pushing events to your app, APIs and SDKs for transfers, batch payouts and expense sync, and AgentOS so AI agents can act on a production account. However, the user must build and host the automation runner themselves, and the 'automate' spend claim is only a tagline. Missing for 10: a native scheduled/recurring automation or workflow builder, documented autonomous background agent execution hosted by Airwallex, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
